title: Central West Alerts 1.11.3
changes: System Admin accounts can receive system-message pushes for new user applications and decoder USB faults.
A decoder watchdog restarts a stalled receiver 30 seconds after a USB transfer error and reports its status to admins.
BOM weather warnings now appear above Fire Danger Ratings; Total Fire Ban areas use a more prominent card header.
Added an experimental AIS Stream vessel layer with server-side configuration.
